School of Engineering
Introduction
  • Modern SOC Bottlenecks: Enterprise analysts face alert fatigue with 70%+ false positives, siloed network PCAP streams, and disconnected SIEM log indexes.
  • Research Objective: Architect a local-first cybersecurity platform combining real-time packet capture, enterprise SIEM queries, and dual-tier machine learning.
  • Mathematical Risk Formulation: Multi-factor risk engine synthesizes ML attack probability, failed attempt counts, and target asset value:
Risk Score = min(100.0, P(Attack) × 80 + ∑wi·Severityi + AssetWeight)
  • Dynamic thresholds: Low (0–39), Medium (40–69), High (70–89), and Critical (90–100).
Methodology & Architecture
  • Telemetry Ingestion: Continuous packet capture via TShark CLI / Wireshark (`socchess://`) plus Splunk Enterprise REST API (Port 8089).
  • Big Data Streaming: Apache Spark 3.5.3 normalizes 12 raw log formats across 3,708 dataset files (CIC-IDS, UNSW-NB15, KDD-99).
Figure 1. High-level system architecture of the SOC CHESS platform: Ingestion, Spark feature extraction, dual-tier ML, and SOAR containment.
  • 19 Canonical Features: Extracted flow rates, packet lengths, TCP flags (SYN, ACK, PSH, FIN, RST), and window sizes.
  • Pre-processing: Symmetrical Log1p smoothing x' = ln(1 + |x|) and Z-score standardization.
Figure 2. Top 10 canonical flow features ranked by information gain in detecting malicious network traffic.
Dual-Tier AI Detection Engine
  • Tier 1 (Real-Time Stream): 3-Layer Multi-Layer Perceptron (128 → 64 → 32 ReLU + Softmax) operating at < 1.2 ms latency per event.
  • Tier 2 (Batch Champion): Scikit-Learn Random Forest (200 trees) + XGBoost achieving 99.39% accuracy.

SOAR & Live Verification
  • 4-Tier Cascading LLM Gateway: NVIDIA NIM (Llama-3.2) → OpenAI GPT-4o → Google Gemini → Local Deterministic Rule Fallback.
  • Auto Firewall Containment: Dynamically generates OS-specific mitigation scripts (Linux iptables DROP, Windows netsh advfirewall).

Conclusions
  • Unified Telemetry: Successfully bridged live PCAP dissection and enterprise SIEM indexes into a synchronized command center.
  • Exceptional Precision: Champion Random Forest achieved 99.39% accuracy and MLP achieved < 1.2 ms latency, effectively solving alert fatigue.
  • Future Work: Integrate kernel-level eBPF / DPDK for 10Gbps line-rate packet capture and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for Active Directory attack graphs.
